title: Fix the team's .gitlab-ci.yml
problem: The pipeline runs on every push, but it uses python:latest, commits an OAuth secret in variables:, downloads every package on every run, and runs ruff check, ruff format --check and pytest in one script line, so a lint failure can't fail the job. Fix it.
requirements: Every job that runs a check uses a python:3.12... image (set it in default: or in the job), not latest
No variable whose name looks like a secret (SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN, API_KEY) in the file, at the top level or in jobs
PIP_CACHE_DIR points inside $CI_PROJECT_DIR, and the cache for those jobs has that path under paths: and key: files: [requirements.txt]
pip install -r requirements.txt runs (in before_script or script) before any check
ruff check, ruff format --check and pytest each run as their own script line
contract: A file named .gitlab-ci.yml in this folder (in a repository: at the root), parsed with yaml.safe_load. Jobs are the top-level keys that aren't global keywords like default, stages or variables.
expectedBehavior: All six tests pass. On GitLab, a push would start the jobs in a python:3.12 image, restore pip's cache when requirements.txt hasn't changed, and fail if any of the three checks fails. OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET would come from a masked project CI/CD variable.
edgeCases: A job-level keyword replaces default: entirely (it doesn't merge)
Cache paths outside the project directory don't work
`a ; b ; c` in one script line reports only the last command's exit code
Splitting checks into two jobs (lint and test) is fine; each must get the image, cache and install
hints: Conceptual: each job runs in a fresh container from its image, with your repository checked out in $CI_PROJECT_DIR. Anything you want to keep between pipelines (pip's downloads) must be listed as a cache inside that directory, and every script line's exit code matters on its own.

Specific: move the shared settings (image, cache, the install in before_script) into default:, point pip's cache into the project with the PIP_CACHE_DIR variable, delete the secret from the file, and split the combined line into separate script items.

Implementation: default: image: python:3.12-slim; cache: key: files: [requirements.txt], paths: [.cache/pip]; before_script: [python -m pip install -r requirements.txt]. variables: PIP_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.cache/pip". Jobs: lint with script [ruff check ., ruff format --check .] and test with script [pytest -q].
evaluation: The removed secret is described as a masked (and, for production values, protected) CI/CD variable, and the old value is rotated because it is in Git history
stages: lists the stage the jobs use
